Royal Privileges

Days made for royalty

Swim above the town, linger over high tea, watch the paddy fields turn gold, and explore the road between Colombo and Kandy.

Scroll

At The Pharo

Slow days, golden evenings

Whether you're here for a night on the way to the hills or a long weekend of celebrations, there's always something waiting on the rooftop, at the table or just down the road.

01

The rooftop

Rooftop pool

Our pool sits on the roof, with loungers, shade and views over the green fields of Nittambuwa. Come for a morning swim or a lazy afternoon.

02

Evenings

The sky lounge

As the day cools, the sky lounge comes alive. It's our favourite spot for sunsets, birthdays and get-togethers.

03

The view

Paddy-field views

From our balconies and terraces, the paddy fields roll out to a line of palms. Order breakfast outside and watch the morning mist lift.

04

Afternoons

High tea & Café Brew

An unhurried pause of cakes and a pot of Ceylon tea, by the garden and terrace.

Explore dining

Beyond the palace

Explore the Kandy road

Nittambuwa sits on the Colombo–Kandy road, an easy base for the island's capital, its hill country and its temples. Ask our team to help plan your day.

𓊽

Attanagalla Rajamaha Viharaya

A historic Buddhist temple close to Nittambuwa.

𓃰

Pinnawala

Home of the famous elephant orphanage, further along the road to Kandy.

𓇳

Kandy

The hill capital and the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

𓈖

Negombo

Beaches and the lagoon, near the international airport.

𓉔

Colombo

Sri Lanka's busy commercial capital, back down the A1.

𓂀

Bandaranaike Airport

The island's main international gateway at Katunayake.
